title: Weekly Schedule Import Payload
$comment: Rules for generating JSON: The image is a 7-column week view ordered left to right. If at least one column date is readable, that day is the anchor day and all other column dates are inferred by adding or subtracting whole days from the anchor based on column position. Every event must contain its final absolute ISO date. The month and year come from the current local date at import time. If a parsed day number is invalid for the current month, clamp it to day 28. If no column date is readable at all, emit no events. Events within the same day are ordered by start time. For every event except the last event of the day, end time equals the next event start time. For the last event of the day, duration is 30 minutes for Растяжки, 2 hours for Балет, and 1 hour otherwise.
